trust_decision.summary: An untrusted header value (request Content-Type or per-part Content-Disposition) is tokenised into parameters by OPTION_RE, whose QUOTED_STR alternation (\\. | [^"]) both match a backslash and backtrack catastrophically; this happens in parse_options_header.

landing_point.why: The advisory names Content-Type header ReDoS; parse_options_header is the only header parser and sits right below the OPTION_RE definition.

fix_sites.entry_point: public API multipart.multipart.parse_options_header (imported directly by downstream frameworks); reached via create_form_parser / parse_form (multipart/multipart.py:1824) and per-part Content-Disposition in FormParser multipart mode (multipart/multipart.py:1694)
fix_sites.module_kind: core parser module (same file as all callers)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: None of substance: the only plausible one is that the per-part Content-Disposition route (multipart/multipart.py:1694) is 'not Content-Type', but it calls the same function, so fixing the function fixes it.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Quoted values must keep semicolons and unescape \" and \\; the IE6 full-path filename must still be reduced to its basename; a bare type with no params must still be returned lower-cased. Removing quoted-string support or truncating input would break these.

O6_input_shapes: str header value (fix.diff:38-42 normalises bytes to str)
quoted parameter values with escapes, handled by email.message.Message.get_params (fix.diff:53-55)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A regex-based parser for Content-Transfer-Encoding or per-part Content-Type parameters (e.g. charset) on part headers
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Part headers are collected into a dict at multipart/multipart.py:1682-1683 and only Content-Disposition is parsed; a maintainer adding charset support would plausibly copy the OPTION_RE idiom into a second helper.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A regex-based parse of X-File-Name or an RFC 2231 filename* option
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: trust_x_headers is accepted but unused; adding filename* / X-File-Name decoding is a natural feature that would reuse a quoted-string regex in a separate function.

O9_family: ReDoS (CWE-1333) in an HTTP header parameter tokeniser

O10_build.project_tests: tests/test_multipart.py:230-272 TestParseOptionsHeader (simple, blank, params, quoted, semicolons, escapes, IE6 filename)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Make QUOTED_STR unambiguous ("(?:\\.|[^"\\])*") or switch to email.message.Message; both fix the single site completely.

out_of_scope_notes: Unbounded buffering of part header names/values (multipart/multipart.py:1676-1683) is a separate resource-exhaustion concern, not this advisory.
